questions.question: Most likely parasitic infection of a child with unilateral subacute vision loss and hyperemia? No other details given

parts.text: C) Most likely way to make the dx?

cohort_answer.text:
Ancylostoma caninum (southern US); Baylisascaris procyonis (Midwest, northwest US). DDx: Toxoplasmosis, Toxocara canis, Gnathostoma spinigerum, Strongyloides stercoralis, Brugia malayi
Albendazole 400mg/day x30 days; Prednisone taper due to vision loss; Photocoagulation if worm visualized
Fundoscopic exam
